segments.text:
V. 43.
He charged them th•t 〈◊〉 man ſhould know it—That He might avoid every Appearance of Vain glory, might prevent too great a Concourſe of People, and might not farther enrage the Scribes and Phariſees againſt Him; the Time for his Death, and for the full Manifeſtation of his Glory, b•ing not yet come. He commanded ſomething ſhould be given her to eat—So that when either natural or ſpi••tual Life is reſtored, even by immediate Miracle, all proper Means are to be uſed in order to preſerve it.
